lines.trans: This shoot was a big mistake.
Why do you say that?
Playing the ideal couple makes no sense.
We never talk about our real worries.
Do you have worries between you two?
He acts as though everything were fine.
He always wants to joke with everyone.
Me, I prefer to speak about real things.
So after five months, the tension exploded.
Do you have news from him today?
No, he still refuses to speak to me.
It weighs on me to hurt him.
Look through the window, they are still there!
Leave me alone, go away from here!

examples.text: Ça va? Oui, ça va bien.
examples.trans: How are you? Yes, I'm fine.

meanings.note: ça va? = how are you? / are you okay?

examples.text: Après, elles ne peuvent plus s'arrêter.
On mange, et après on part.
examples.trans: We eat, and afterwards we leave.

meanings.note: aucune before a feminine noun; usually with ne

examples.text: Il y a un macaron sur la table.
examples.trans: There's a macaron on the table.

meanings.note: elle a quarante ans = she is forty

meanings.en: il y a = there is / there are

meanings.note: as a masculine noun: pour le bien de = for the good of
before a noun: ce film, cette tête, ces gens
as a pronoun in c'est, ce n'est pas; becomes c' before a vowel
autre chose = something else, anything else

examples.text: Monsieur Audibert nous reçoit dans cinq minutes.
examples.trans: Mr Audibert will see us in five minutes.
I'll be there in five minutes.

meanings.note: the final q is pronounced: sɛ̃k

examples.text: La plus grande imprésario de Paris.

meanings.note: dire la vérité à quelqu'un = to tell someone the truth
encore une heure = one more hour

examples.text: Il n'y a rien entre nous.

meanings.note: entre toi et moi = between you and me
pour faire quoi? = to do what?
faire du vélo = to ride a bike, to cycle

examples.text: Regardez, il y a une fenêtre là-haut!
examples.trans: Look, there's a window up there!

examples.text: Tu es l'amant idéal, c'est ça?
examples.trans: You're the ideal lover, is that it?

examples.text: Je ne suis jamais en retard.
Il joue le frère de Guillaume.

meanings.note: jouer un rôle, jouer le frère de...
jouer au foot, jouer du piano
before the verb: vous la connaissez? les voilà

examples.text: Je ne veux pas te faire de mal.
examples.trans: I don't want to hurt you.

meanings.note: faire du mal à quelqu'un = to hurt someone
object pronoun before the verb: tu me donnes
with reflexive verbs: je me débrouille
tout le monde = everyone; il y a du monde = it's crowded
ne ... pas: not; ne ... plus: not anymore; ne ... jamais: never
tag at the end of a question
everyday speech, with a he/she verb form

examples.text: Par exemple, le contrat de Canet.

meanings.note: no object: je pars = I'm leaving
partir en vacances = to go on holiday

meanings.en: to be heavy, weigh heavily on someone's mind

meanings.note: je préfère = I prefer; tu préférerais = would you rather

examples.text: Dis-lui que je ne peux pas venir.

meanings.note: être refusé(e) = to be turned down

meanings.en: meaning, reason (avoir du sens = to make sense)

examples.text: Si tu veux le rôle, tu dois changer.
examples.trans: If you want the part, you have to change.

examples.text: Le tournage commence dans trois semaines.

meanings.note: from tourner un film = to shoot a film

examples.text: Ça ne va pas du tout.

meanings.note: oui à tout = yes to everything
plural tous (pronounced 'tous' with s): merci à tous
before a noun: tout le monde = everyone

meanings.en: laisser quelqu'un tranquille = to leave someone alone

meanings.note: singular and informal: friends, family, children, colleagues of the same age
+ noun: je veux un café; + infinitive: je veux partir
je vous rappelle = I'll call you back
